tools.name: get-model-structure
tools.description: Get the structure of a GLTF/GLB model file. This tool loads the file and returns the parsed scene structure as JSON, using GLTFStructureLoader from gltfjsx. Use this tool for complex model debugging and not implementation. For code generation use the gltfx tool.

modelPath.description: The path to the GLTF/GLB model file to get the structure of. The path should be absolute on the file system. Do not use relative paths.

annotations.title: Get the structure of a GLTF/GLB model file. Useful for complex model debugging and not implementation. For code generation use the gltfx tool.

tools.name: gltfjsx
tools.description: Converts a GLTF/GLB 3D model file into a reusable, declarative React (react-three-fiber) JSX component. Supports options for TypeScript output, mesh/material instancing, pruning, compression, texture format, mesh simplification, and more. Useful for integrating 3D assets into React apps with optimal performance and flexibility.

modelPath.description: The path to the GLTF/GLB model file to convert to JSX. The path should be absolute. The path should be absolute on the file system. Do not use relative paths.

types.description: Add Typescript definitions to the output

keepnames.description: Keep original node names from the GLTF file

keepgroups.description: Keep (empty) groups, disable pruning of empty transforms

meta.description: Include metadata (as userData) in the output

shadows.description: Let meshes cast and receive shadows

precision.description: Number of fractional digits for floats (default: 3)

instance.description: Instance re-occurring geometry for cheaper re-use

exportdefault.description: Use default export for the generated component

annotations.title: Convert GLTF/GLB to React JSX component
